items.hed: The Rockets host Denver tonight at Toyota Center with Nikola Jokic now on the Nuggets' injury report
items.insight: Houston's official schedule has tipoff at 7:30 p.m. Central tonight against Denver. The Rockets enter at 7-3 after Saturday's 102-99 road loss at Phoenix snapped a five-game winning streak, and they also dropped a 10-point decision to Minnesota earlier in the week. Denver arrives banged up: every starter from the team's win over Indiana is on the injury report, including Jokic, and the Nuggets have been dealing with travel fatigue after mechanical delays on a flight out of Mexico.

items.hed: New GM Randy Flores heads into this week's GM Meetings with a manager still to hire and a possible Dec. 1 lockout looming
items.insight: The Houston Chronicle reports Flores, who officially took over as general manager Oct. 30 and was introduced publicly Nov. 2 at Daikin Park, enters the annual General Managers Meetings this week needing to fill the manager's chair left open since Joe Espada's departure, weigh roster questions, and plan around a possible Dec. 1 work stoppage. MLB.com confirms Flores will attend the meetings in his new capacity leading Astros baseball operations. As of this afternoon, no manager hire had been announced.

items.hed: The Texans, fresh off a 44-22 rout of the Chargers, travel to Cleveland for a Week 10 game Nov. 15
items.insight: Houston improved to 3-5 with Sunday's 44-22 win over Los Angeles at SoFi Stadium, the team's clearest performance of the season. The Texans' official schedule has them next facing the Browns on the road at Huntington Bank Field on Sunday, Nov. 15, looking to build on Sunday's result heading into the back half of the season.
